name: Product story
steps: Open Online Store > Themes > Customize for an unpublished copy. Choose the page template, select Add section, and choose Product story.
Start with Manual blocks and add story text, images, or timeline items. Use Split for a lead image beside the story; additional media remains in the content.

For advanced data, select a product metafield. A reference entry may supply heading, content, media_image, media_video, media_caption, and timeline_items. A timeline list uses title, date, text, and image fields.
Select Add block inside this section. Use the supported block types listed below, then drag them into the desired reading order.
Connect your own content and media before adjusting layout, typography, color, and spacing. Section overrides take priority where the section offers them.
Preview desktop and mobile, test any links or controls, and save. Publish only after reviewing the complete customer journey.

settings.label: Metafield namespace (when source = metafield)
settings.how: Advanced: enter the namespace of an existing Shopify metafield definition, such as custom. It must match the definition exactly. Pair it with the corresponding key; this setting does not create a definition.

settings.label: Metafield key (when source = metafield)
settings.how: Advanced: enter the existing metafield key or content field key described below. Match the spelling exactly and use the data type expected by this section. Use manual content first if no matching definition exists.
